title: Kai Governance Intent Contract V1.0
description: Governance Intent is declarative, not executable. Structural validity is not authentication, approval or execution authorization.

intent_id.description: Unique governance request identity. Uniqueness must be enforced outside JSON Schema.

requester.description: Identity bound by an authenticated ingress, never established by a model's self-report.

environment.description: Registry identity only, not a hostname, IP address or SSH destination; Registry resolution is an external semantic check.

target.description: Logical resource within the bound environment, such as service/nginx or robot/arm01. No execution method.

purpose.description: User goal summary only, not chain of thought, a prompt or executable instructions.

approval.description: Trusted-policy approval requirement and optional opaque record reference. A null reference may mean pending; a reference does not prove approval.

verification.description: Verification requirement, not evidence or a claim of success. Version 1.0 supports observation evidence only.
